# @ndigo/advice

Runs the advice declared by annotations — rules, plan compilation, and weaving for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `ruleOrder` — The order a rule's advice executes in: the rule's own `order` when set, otherwise the interceptor's, otherwise DEFAULT_ADVICE_ORDER.
- `sortRules` — Stable sort of rules by effective order; equal orders keep registration order, so a registry's insertion sequence is the tie-breaker.
- `invokeChain` — Runs one call through the compiled advice chain.
- `annotatedMembers` — The member-scoped keys a class declares.
- `unadvisedAnnotationWarning` — Builds the warning for a class whose annotated methods nothing advises, or `undefined` when there is nothing to report.
- `AnnotationKey` *(type)*
- `ClassAnnotationKey` *(type)*
- `MethodAnnotationKey` *(type)*
- `MethodDescriptor` *(type)* — Static description of one managed method, shared by all of its calls.
- `MethodInvocation` *(type)* — One managed call: the MethodDescriptor plus the receiver and the arguments for this invocation.
- `MethodInterceptor` *(type)* — A unit of cross-cutting policy: it runs around a matched call.
- `MethodInterceptorRule` *(type)* — Binds an interceptor to the methods it advises.
- `createMethodDescriptor` — Builds the immutable descriptor used for selection and annotation lookup.
- `hasAnnotation` — Matches methods that carry an annotation, optionally narrowing by value.
- `AdviceOrder` — The conventional order bands.
- `DEFAULT_ADVICE_ORDER` — The position a rule occupies when neither it nor its interceptor names one.
- `AdviceOrderBand` *(type)* — The conventional order band values.
- `MethodInterceptorPlan` *(type)* — One method with the advice that runs around it, fixed at weave time.
- `compileInterceptorPlan` — Compiles rules against a set of method names.
- `interception` — Builds the single initialization-aware processor that advises container entries.
- `weaveMethodProxy` — Wraps `target` in a `Proxy` that advises the compiled plans.
- `MethodInterceptorRegistry` — Ordered, identity-deduplicated collection of advice rules.
- `AdviceStrategy` *(type)* — How an instance's methods were advised.
- `methodSurfaceOf` — The prototype object whose methods make up `instance`'s surface. Function targets are class-shaped — their methods live on `.prototype` — while arrow and bound…
- `targetTypeOf` — The class that declares `instance`'s shape. A function target is its own class; otherwise the prototype's constructor is used so a proxy-shaped instance does n…
- `entryNameOf` — The entry name a standalone-woven instance is described under: its class name, falling back to `'intercepted'`.
- `enumerateMethodNames` — String-named data methods on the instance's surface: the surface plus its prototype chain, excluding `Object.prototype` and `constructor`.
- `shadowObstacle` — Whether `instance` can be shadow-woven, and why not when it cannot.
- `isShadowWoven` — Whether `instance` was already shadow-woven.
- `shadowWeave` — Installs advice wrappers for the compiled plans on `instance`.
- `WeaveResult` *(type)* — The outcome of weaving one instance.
- `isWoven` — Whether an object (or the instance it stands in for) has been advised.
- `wovenBy` — The processor that wove `instance`, or `undefined` when it was advised standalone or not advised at all.
- `markWovenBy` — Records which processor owns a woven object. Called by the container processor; standalone callers never use it.
- `weaveInstance` — Compiles `rules` against `instance`'s method surface and weaves it, using shadow weaving when possible and a `Proxy` when not.
- `weavePlans` — Weaves already-compiled plans, choosing the strategy for the instance.
- `interceptMethods` — Advises an object without a container.
- `createIntercepted` — Constructs and advises in one step.
- `planFor` — The compiled plans for an instance without weaving it — useful for diagnostics that report which methods would be advised.
- `createAdviceWrapper` — Builds the function that runs an advice chain and then the declared method.
